entries.heading: DEFENSE HEALTH PROGRAM
ancestors: TITLE XV—AUTHORIZATION OF ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATIONS FOR OVERSEAS CONTINGENCY OPERATIONS
entries.text:
SEC. 1510. DEFENSE HEALTH PROGRAM.

    Funds are hereby authorized to be appropriated for the Department of 
Defense for fiscal year 2018 for expenses, not otherwise provided for, 
for the Defense Health Program, as specified in the funding table in 
section 4502.

                      Subtitle B--Financial Matters
